title: Transit Report
description: Grouped controls for full loading screens. Short transitions show the indicator only.

.label: Theme
.hint: Choose a faction, or Random Each Load to pick one faction per loading screen. Artwork slots set to Theme share that choice. Other artwork choices stay independent.

.label: Character badge
.hint: Theme uses the selected faction artwork (or Orbiting Star/Orbital Chart with Individual selections). All other choices apply independently. Choose a built-in design or Custom. Custom randomly selects a PNG/JPG/JPEG/GIF from Documents/My Games/Starfield/Transit Report/Artwork/Badges each load. Any filenames; up to 64 images. Restart after changes.

.label: Loading indicator
.hint: Theme uses the selected faction artwork (or Orbiting Star/Orbital Chart with Individual selections). All other choices apply independently. Choose a built-in design or Custom. Custom randomly selects a PNG/JPG/JPEG/GIF from Documents/My Games/Starfield/Transit Report/Artwork/Indicators each load. Any filenames; up to 64 images. Restart after changes.

.label: Loading background
.hint: Theme uses the selected faction artwork (or Orbiting Star/Orbital Chart with Individual selections). All other choices apply independently. Choose a built-in design or Custom. Custom randomly selects a PNG/JPG/JPEG/GIF from Documents/My Games/Starfield/Transit Report/Artwork/Backgrounds each load. Any filenames; up to 64 images. Restart after changes.

.label: Character badge size
.hint: Scale independently from the enlarged baseline. Normal (100%) equals the previous 150% size.

.label: Loading indicator size
.hint: Scale independently from the enlarged baseline. Normal (100%) equals the previous 150% size.

.label: Lifetime stats
.hint: Show randomized lifetime statistics on full loading screens.

.label: Loading tips
.hint: Show loading tips on loading screens.

.label: Local PC time
.hint: Your computer clock in its local time zone. Updates during loading.

.label: Number of stat pages
.hint: Maximum 1–5 pages per full load, with four larger lifetime readings per page. Default: two pages.

.label: Hide zero-value stats
.hint: Omit numeric zero readings before building pages, including random highlights. Empty pages are not displayed.
